name: Galaxy USDC Quality
oneLiner: Galaxy USDC Quality is a Galaxy-curated Morpho V2 USDC lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDC-denominated lender positions in Galaxy-curated Morpho markets targeting blue-chip borrower collateral. At the reviewed Ethereum block, claims were about 71.29% against WBTC, 26.24% cbBTC and 2.47% weETH, plus wstETH dust; these are lending allocations, not direct collateral holdings. Custodial BTC backing creates mixed look-through custody.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDC for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDC and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets. VaultV2 maxWithdraw and maxRedeem deliberately return zero as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity. At the reviewed pin, the current adapter's force-deallocation penalty is 0% of assets deallocated; this separate route still requires market liquidity and is not an ordinary withdrawal fee.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: At Ethereum block 26197000 (2026-10-15T09:24:59Z; hash 0x7f8f6377ac8f3948e1ac61d81c1a236b58c7ef57ef2743f18189cca1127aa66d), asset() is USDC, totalSupply()=9981619073650174219359686 raw 18-decimal shares and totalAssets()=10183216864889 raw 6-decimal USDC. adaptersLength()=1 and adapters(0)=0x7df529c92b5744b13be10f06e0c0846186a24f79. Its four market IDs reconcile expectedSupplyAssets to realAssets()=10183216864889; idle USDC=0. Lender-claim allocations are WBTC 71.29467103%, cbBTC 26.23508602%, weETH 2.47024295% and wstETH 2 atomic USDC units. These are USDC lender-claim weights by borrower collateral, not holdings of the collateral tokens. All four adapter positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral; immutable market LLTV is 86%. Shares represent a proportional operational lending position whose NAV can fall with losses, rather than direct ownership of Circle reserves. Immediate vault and adapter custody is on-chain. About 97.53% of the lender claims are against custodial WBTC/cbBTC collateral, so whole-book custody is mixed. Coinbase identifies itself as cbBTC backing custodian; WBTC discloses custodial BTC reserves without allocating this vault to named reserve custodians. No custody-provider share, legal segregation, insolvency priority, independent vault financial assurance or guaranteed stressed realization is inferred. Existing exact-deployment functional compiler correspondence is retained; freshly read runtime matches the explorer deployed bytes and the previously reviewed runtime hex-string SHA-256 80c0341311dfa6073a7bdc893ddb6ec33e85b860beeefc6b267bd329b5ebe7d3. Blockscout still reports is_fully_verified=false; functional correspondence is distinct from complete metadata/compiler verification.
